description:
After a Stressful Day | Slow Tanpura | 1.5 Hours to Set the Day Down

You have done enough today. If you got home wound tight - jaw set, shoulders up by your ears, the day still running in your head - this is ninety minutes to let it all drop.

This deep Indian tanpura drone is designed to release tension after a stressful day: a single warm, continuous sound your nervous system can lean on until the noise fades.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of slow tanpura resonance with gentle harmonic swells, no drums, no melody to follow and no vocals.

▶ Keep unwinding — the full Healing & Anxiety Relief playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199k-_9PNqaU2-Z_KhRN_X1hF
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing — it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for decompressing after work, evening stress relief, burnout recovery, a hot bath, lying on the floor, yoga nidra, breathwork, a quiet dinner, reading, or the hour before bed.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Tanpura (Indian drone instrument), solo
Raga: Yaman (an expansive evening raga)
Style: Indian classical drone, ambient
Mood: Heavy, warm, releasing
Atmosphere: Lamplight, shoes off, the door closed on the day
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Put it on the moment you get home and let it run in the background while you change, eat or lie down. Breathe out longer than you breathe in and let your shoulders drop with each swell. Headphones deepen the drone; a soft speaker fills a room beautifully.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 Setting the day down
9:00 The first long exhale
18:00 Shoulders drop

36:00 Heavy and warm
45:00 Nothing left to do
54:00 Deep resonance

1:12:00 Quiet all the way through
1:21:00 Ready for rest
